topics.name: Robotic manipulation and embodied policy learning
topics.summary: Contact-aware grasping, action chunks, latent actions, and learned dynamics are combined to improve dexterous and long-horizon manipulation. Simulation, synthetic scenes, tactile signals, and hybrid offline-online training recur as ways to reduce data demands while preserving physical reliability.

topics.name: Multi-robot coordination and networked control
topics.summary: Robot teams and networked controllers coordinate under changing partners, limited communication, queueing constraints, and uncertain dynamics. Multi-agent reinforcement learning, game structures, distributed estimation, and fleet-level optimization are evaluated in simulation and hardware-oriented settings.

topics.name: Embodied planning and navigation
topics.summary: Embodied systems translate language, visual context, and geometric visibility into navigation or task actions. Behavior trees, modular runtimes, pose reasoning, future-scene prediction, and handoffs between planning and control support robots, vehicles, and assistance scenarios.

topics.name: Autonomous driving perception and planning
topics.summary: Driving systems combine camera, LiDAR, inertial, event, and bird's-eye-view representations to estimate occupancy, track objects, predict behavior, and select safer actions. Temporal reliability, degraded sensing, scene-conditioned control, and closed-loop robustness are recurring evaluation concerns.

topics.name: 3D reconstruction and scene synthesis
topics.summary: Multi-view geometry, Gaussian primitives, recurrent scene updates, and rendered supervision support reconstruction and generation of spatial environments. The studies address sparse views, changing cameras, scalable layouts, per-frame calibration, and removal of image artifacts that would otherwise corrupt geometry.

topics.name: Visual place recognition and vehicle localization
topics.summary: Long-term localization methods use geometric agreement, temporal consistency, thermal shift detection, and learned filtering to reject false matches and correct drift. Vehicle-focused systems also estimate motion during GNSS or external-velocity outages with uncertainty-aware state updates.

topics.name: Visual grounding and multimodal retrieval
topics.summary: Object relations, temporal evidence, spatial cues, and semantic segmentation are used to connect language queries with visual content. Query-aware frame selection, compositional matching, reasoning diagnostics, and rendered-region grounding reduce irrelevant computation while retaining verifiable answers.

topics.name: Document AI and evidence-grounded retrieval
topics.summary: Document systems organize layout, page relationships, schemas, and source evidence for extraction and question answering. Legal, multilingual, scientific, and multimodal settings use retrieval, reranking, citation checks, or structure-sensitive prompting to improve traceability and fine-grained localization.

topics.name: Video quality, generation and forensic analysis
topics.summary: Quality predictors account for codecs, displays, and viewing conditions, while generative video models provide motion or illumination cues. Forensic systems use causal perturbations and conditioning to detect synthetic content and assess physical consistency across domains.

topics.name: Video-language reasoning and action understanding
topics.summary: Long-video systems improve temporal precision through multiscale evidence selection, claim-level supervision, and process-aware scoring. Related action studies learn unsupervised temporal segments and test industrial safety recognition under difficult surveillance conditions.

topics.name: Diffusion image customization and editing
topics.summary: Adapters, inversion feedback, latent control, tool selection, and intermediate asset tracking support image personalization and reference-preserving edits. The methods target concept interference, semantic fidelity, compositing quality, and reliable interaction with heterogeneous visual tools.

topics.name: Computational imaging and learned compression
topics.summary: Optical multiplexing and differentiable reconstruction recover measurements from ill-conditioned observations, while learned compression discovers reusable transforms and adaptive filters. Across imaging and coding, physical structure is paired with compact learned inference to control complexity and distortion.

topics.name: Robust and geometry-aware visual perception
topics.summary: Depth, symmetry, spectral structure, complementary frames, and architectural regularization improve recognition under fog, attacks, enhancement artifacts, or domain change. Evaluations emphasize downstream detection and identity preservation rather than relying only on generic robustness scores.

topics.name: Industrial inspection and visual anomaly detection
topics.summary: Manufacturing systems combine compact defect localization and severity grading with material identification, while unsupervised methods learn normal structure and score physically plausible deviations. Neighborhood projections and constrained evidence help avoid brittle nearest-neighbor or reconstruction-only decisions.

topics.name: Formal program synthesis and AI-assisted verification
topics.summary: Distributed synthesis, repair, autoformalization, invariant generation, and theorem interfaces convert natural-language or informal specifications into checked artifacts. Feedback from symbolic solvers is used to localize errors and improve correctness across software, optimization, and quantum reasoning tasks.

topics.name: AI coding agents and software testing
topics.summary: Repository-scale agents are assessed through executable tests, mutation and vulnerability benchmarks, workflow mining, and real pull-request behavior. The recurring focus is connecting generated code to maintainability, reliability, energy use, and evidence about affected components.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning for language agents and reasoning
topics.summary: On-policy data, preference labels, verifier feedback, teacher distillation, replay, and self-review are used to improve multistep language-agent behavior. These methods target credit assignment, off-policy error, exploration cost, and recovery from early mistakes in mathematical or interactive tasks.

topics.name: Tool-using agent security and reliability
topics.summary: Tool-augmented agents can omit required calls, misuse returned values, follow hostile retrieved content, or accept forged authority. Benchmarks, adversarial traces, claim checks, privilege-bound gateways, and query anchoring make these failures more observable and constrain harmful execution.

topics.name: Agent memory and self-improvement
topics.summary: Persistent agents organize experience as structured memories, reusable procedures, or continuously updated skills. Work on trace transfer, recursive improvement, video memory, and poisoned recollections shows that retrieval latency, admission rules, and memory structure jointly affect capability and attack exposure.

topics.name: Mechanistic analysis of language models
topics.summary: Probing and intervention studies examine latent signals for generation length, task outcomes, causal feature directions, and internal knowledge use. The results distinguish information that is decodable from information that actually drives behavior, exposing limits of rankings and surface explanations.

topics.name: LLM behavior, prompt robustness and human interaction
topics.summary: Prompt wording, answer order, expectations, repeated-game commitments, tutoring style, and group interaction all affect how people interpret or use language models. Controlled comparisons reveal gaps between apparent cooperation, confidence, pedagogical quality, and stable task competence.

topics.name: AI evaluation, testing and incident governance
topics.summary: Assurance methods combine test-oracle design, confidence estimation, threshold calibration, failure analysis, incident taxonomies, sabotage monitoring, and evolving safety benchmarks. Their shared aim is to produce defensible deployment decisions under limited labels, shifting risks, and cross-model transfer.

topics.name: Language-model and agent benchmark evaluation
topics.summary: Assessment suites separate data resemblance, synthetic-text diversity, local language competence, sustained experience, exploration, tool discovery, and recovery from underspecified tasks. These benchmarks show why leaderboard scores alone do not characterize useful performance in realistic environments.

topics.name: Online credibility and deceptive interface design
topics.summary: Credibility scoring combines temporal evidence about emerging domains with inspection of interface behavior. Studies of misinformation and mobile applications identify reputation gaps, disclosure weaknesses, and recurring manipulative interaction patterns that are missed by content-only analysis.

topics.name: Low-resource language technology
topics.summary: Under-resourced language work builds annotated resources, morphological analyses, aspect-level sentiment data, and semi-supervised speech systems. Cross-lingual transfer and iterative pseudo-labeling help extend coverage when expert annotation is sparse or linguistic variation is substantial.

topics.name: Hate speech and antisemitism detection
topics.summary: Fine-grained language-model evaluations use expert taxonomies, definitions, examples, and event-level labels to analyze antisemitic discourse. Conceptual grounding can improve recall, but subtle rhetoric, lexical shortcuts, calibration, and precision remain difficult.

topics.name: Behavioral health and mental-health language modeling
topics.summary: Social-media and conversational data are modeled with emotional, temporal, interpersonal, and circadian signals to study substance use, depression, disclosure, and support seeking. Results provide population-level associations but caution against treating linguistic separation as individual diagnosis.

topics.name: Computational molecular discovery and genomics
topics.summary: Chemical route planning, tandem-spectrum interpretation, drug-response modeling, Bayesian genomic mixtures, and federated single-cell learning address discovery under incomplete or distributed evidence. Validation emphasizes chemically plausible structures, calibrated uncertainty, regulatory mechanisms, and privacy-preserving biological inference.

topics.name: Clinical imaging, pathology and disease phenotyping
topics.summary: Clinical vision studies cover segmentation with partial labels, few-shot delineation, pathology adaptation, lesion detection, severity grading, radiology schemas, wound monitoring, and label consensus. Anatomical structure, hard-negative handling, uncertainty, and cross-site generalization recur across datasets.

topics.name: Biosignal and sleep analysis
topics.summary: EMG, IMU, EEG, respiration video, and bedside measurements are represented with frequency structure, cross-modal embeddings, temporal models, or distributional targets. The applications include movement scoring, sleep staging, neonatal monitoring, and psychiatric classification under subject and dataset variation.

topics.name: Speech decoding, audio datasets and speech-language modeling
topics.summary: Audio research spans speech and articulatory decoding, brain interfaces, provenance-aware sound collections, speaker separation, unified codecs, conversational timing, recognition diagnostics, translation, and multimodal question answering. Robustness to speakers, languages, artifacts, and streaming constraints is central.

topics.name: Physics-informed dynamics and transfer learning
topics.summary: Neural dynamics models incorporate governing equations, graph structure, advection, equivariance, or morphology-aligned latent spaces to model damage, transport, molecular forces, and underwater robots. Transfer and topology-aware adaptation reduce data requirements while protecting against negative transfer and noisy supervision.

topics.name: Geospatial, climate and environmental forecasting
topics.summary: Spatial graphs, coordinates, remote sensing, biomass references, station guidance, attribution tools, diffusion refinement, and new atmospheric observations improve forecasts of mobility, forests, pollution, clouds, temperature, and precipitation. Evaluation emphasizes fine-scale structure, extremes, transfer, and interpretability.

topics.name: Diffusion sampling theory
topics.summary: Finite-sample analyses of score learning and conditional particle methods separate optimization, approximation, discretization, initialization, kernel, and Monte Carlo effects. These guarantees clarify which components dominate error when diffusion and sequential sampling methods are implemented at practical scales.

topics.name: Conditional generative inference and uncertainty
topics.summary: Flow-based inference, energy objectives, conformal procedures, and robust regression provide distributions or guarantees instead of single predictions. The applications include multimodal inverse problems, nonrandom missing data, clinical imputation, and optimization under covariate shift.

topics.name: Risk-sensitive reinforcement learning and offline evaluation
topics.summary: Sequential decision methods address delayed observations, risk measures, continuous planning, and policy evaluation without exhaustive search. Structural coverage, occupancy-ratio estimation, and efficient tail-risk computation support finite-sample guarantees under uncertainty and distribution shift.

topics.name: Representation learning and continual adaptation
topics.summary: Hierarchical prompts, probabilistic diversity, curriculum order, replay, finite-step optimization, variance-aware sampling, and orthogonality shape reusable representations. The studies target data scarcity, continual class growth, disentanglement, inactive latent dimensions, memorization, and catastrophic forgetting.

topics.name: Graph and relational machine learning systems
topics.summary: Graph methods are optimized across model scale, temporal sampling, memory use, kernels, categorical distances, and community structure. Transferable optimizer settings and structure-preserving mini-batches improve scalability and partition quality on relational and graph data.

topics.name: Fairness and bias measurement
topics.summary: Fairness analyses connect prediction disparities to functional dependence, causal pathways, research concentration, and language-model associations. Explicit structural definitions and probability-based measurements reveal tradeoffs that generic penalties or aggregate field statistics can obscure.

topics.name: Privacy-preserving and governed AI workflows
topics.summary: Secure computation, local randomization, contextual-integrity policies, consent contracts, projected views, signed privilege changes, and auditability constrain access and updates in shared AI workflows. The common objective is preserving useful inference and collaboration without relying only on model discretion.

topics.name: Agentic operational workflows
topics.summary: Domain-specific agent pipelines decompose requests, call tools, validate intermediate artifacts, and produce structured outputs for cybersecurity and healthcare operations. Their evaluations emphasize controllability, safe orchestration, and evidence that automation remains aligned with specialist workflows.

topics.name: Engineering automation and 3D CAD
topics.summary: Natural-language engineering systems generate parts, interfaces, assemblies, simulations, and training artifacts, while vision-language models abstract shapes into primitives or parametric CAD. Rendered critique, schema checks, geometric reasoning, and segmentation quality determine practical reliability.

topics.name: Efficient language-model inference and long-context modeling
topics.summary: KV-cache selection, speculative verification, structured narrative memory, and alternative sequence-mixing mechanisms reduce the cost of long autoregressive workloads. The methods balance retained context, acceptance rate, temporal coherence, and serving efficiency at extended sequence lengths.

topics.name: Modular adaptation and expert routing
topics.summary: Independent predictors, mixture-of-experts components, and parameter-efficient adapters distribute specialization across data regimes and modalities. Diversity and context-sensitive routing are used to reduce imbalance, interference, and the cost of adapting one monolithic model.

topics.name: Open-world classification under distribution shift
topics.summary: Classifier adaptation addresses changing label proportions and emerging categories through simplex-aware estimation and temporary class representations. Both approaches aim to discover new structure without sacrificing recognition of established classes.

topics.name: Quantum machine learning and system diagnostics
topics.summary: Quantum learning, harmonic search, spectral anomaly scoring, and backend fingerprinting translate quantum structure into trainable or diagnostic computation. The studies examine optimization, noisy-device identification, and privacy limits without requiring complete state reconstruction.

topics.name: Clinically interpretable multimodal learning
topics.summary: Biological pathways and retinal structures are made explicit in multimodal predictors by linking images, omics, biomarkers, and disease mechanisms. Structured graphs and pathway-constrained latent models improve interpretability for systemic risk and cancer subtype analysis.

topics.name: Market decision optimization
topics.summary: Pricing and intervention policies model interactions among sellers, shops, treatments, or platform users rather than optimizing isolated outcomes. Graph-based multi-agent learning and uplift objectives address partial information, substitution, and platform-wide incremental value.

topics.name: Scheduling and resource allocation
topics.summary: Constraint programming and reinforcement learning handle labor rules, coverage, batching, routing, heterogeneous accelerators, and changing demand. The methods optimize service quality and operational stability while respecting hard feasibility requirements.

topics.name: Edge and neuromorphic AI hardware
topics.summary: Compute-in-memory partitioning, endurance-aware execution, optical tactile sensing, spiking classifiers, distillation, binary arithmetic, and compact spike sorting target low-power deployment. Hardware-aware training preserves task utility while reducing memory, latency, or energy demands.

topics.name: Safe foundation-model editing
topics.summary: Targeted model changes are constrained with subspace projections, trusted adapter directions, and clinical stress tests. Evaluation covers erasure, locality, poisoning resistance, transfer, composition, and whether intended behavior changes leak into unrelated capabilities.

topics.name: Multi-agent deliberation and verified orchestration
topics.summary: Cooperative model committees and declarative solver workflows combine generation with critique, scoring distributions, structured aggregation, or machine-checkable computation. Heterogeneous agents and explicit decision protocols improve calibration and intermediate reasoning across technical tasks.

topics.name: Multimodal visualization-to-code generation
topics.summary: Chart and dashboard systems are evaluated on both visual fidelity and interactive behavior. Benchmarks and training methods address latent data ambiguity, user exploration, rendered interaction, and dynamic testing of generated visualization code.

topics.name: LLM-guided automated algorithm design
topics.summary: Language models act as mutation, transfer, reflection, or proposal operators inside searches for neural architectures, Bayesian optimizers, and combinatorial heuristics. Quality-diversity archives and source-guided exploration broaden candidate solutions while improving benchmark performance.

topics.name: Efficient retrieval and query routing for language agents
topics.summary: Retrieval controllers use prompt-tuned routing, graph-action policies, similarity caches, and compact language models to manage latency and interaction cost. The results favor inspectable control over unnecessary pre-search deliberation and repeated large-model calls.

topics.name: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding
topics.summary: Language-aligned point features, scene graphs, part references, and metric reasoning connect open-ended questions to spatial structure. The systems aim for consistent object grounding and measurable answers across unfamiliar categories and physical layouts.
